token_balance_coverage: SELECT slot, COUNT(*) AS packages, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_status='ERROR') AS failed_packages_retained, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE token_balance_observations_state='VALUE' AND len(token_balance_observations)>0) AS packages_with_recorded_balances, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE token_balance_observations_state='VALUE' AND len(token_balance_observations)=0) AS empty_or_not_recorded_packages, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE token_balance_observations_state<>'VALUE') AS projection_unavailable_packages, SUM(len(token_balance_observations)) AS recorded_observations FROM bronze GROUP BY slot ORDER BY slot
token_balance_mints: SELECT o.mint, o.program_id, o.decimals, o.decimals_field_state, o.side, o.disposition, COUNT(*) AS observations, COUNT(DISTINCT b.record_ordinal) AS packages, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.transaction_status='ERROR') AS observations_in_failed_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT o.account_key) AS account_keys, COUNT(DISTINCT o.owner) AS owners FROM bronze b, UNNEST(b.token_balance_observations) AS t(o) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY o.mint,o.program_id,o.decimals,o.decimals_field_state,o.side,o.disposition
token_balance_presence: SELECT o.side,o.disposition,o.reason,o.account_index_field_state,o.decimals_field_state,o.ui_token_amount_present,o.amount_present,o.owner_present,o.program_id_present,COUNT(*) AS observations FROM bronze b,UNNEST(b.token_balance_observations) AS t(o) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
token_balance_decimal_consistency: SELECT o.mint,o.program_id,COUNT(DISTINCT o.decimals) AS observed_decimal_scales,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.decimals IS NULL) AS observations_without_decimals,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.disposition<>'PROJECTED') AS incomplete_or_quarantined_observations,COUNT(*) AS observations FROM bronze b,UNNEST(b.token_balance_observations) AS t(o) GROUP BY o.mint,o.program_id ORDER BY o.mint,o.program_id
trade_units: SELECT slot,transaction_index,is_buy,mint,transaction_status,units_binding_status,units_base_mint,units_base_token_program,units_decimals,units_decimals_evidence,token_amount_raw_u64,units_event_token_amount_raw_u64,units_event_token_amount_decimal,amount_raw_u64,min_sol_output_raw_u64,spendable_quote_in_raw_u64,min_tokens_out_raw_u64,base_decimals,quote_decimals,outer_index,instruction_inner_order,event_inner_order,raw_sha256,bronze_record_sha256,record_sha256 FROM silver ORDER BY record_ordinal
trade_balance_roles: SELECT s.slot,s.transaction_index,s.mint,s.is_buy,s.units_binding_status,r.role,r.account_index,r.account_key,r.expected_owner,len(r.pre_observation_indexes) AS recorded_pre_matches,len(r.post_observation_indexes) AS recorded_post_matches,r.transaction_delta_raw_signed,r.delta_status,s.bronze_record_sha256,s.record_sha256 FROM silver s,UNNEST(s.units_role_balances) AS t(r) ORDER BY s.record_ordinal,r.account_index,r.role
trade_balance_observations: SELECT b.slot,b.transaction_index,b.transaction_status,global_ordinal-1 AS observation_index,o.ordinal AS side_ordinal,o.side,o.account_index,o.account_key,o.mint,o.owner,o.program_id,o.amount_string,o.amount_u64,o.decimals,o.decimals_field_state,o.exact_decimal_amount,o.disposition,o.reason,o.raw_token_balance_sha256,b.metadata_sha256,b.raw_sha256,b.record_sha256 FROM bronze b,UNNEST(b.token_balance_observations) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(o,global_ordinal) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM silver s WHERE s.bronze_record_sha256=b.record_sha256 AND list_contains(s.units_matched_observation_indexes,global_ordinal-1)) ORDER BY b.record_ordinal,global_ordinal
